quotes.quote: Utilizing high molecular weight DNA and linked-read sequencing technology, we assembled a draft high-quality genome
with highly contiguous scaffolds (scaffold N50 = 19 Mb). Based on universal single-copy orthologs, we estimated a gene space completeness of 96.6% for the draft genome assembly.

G1.rationale: The principal result is a genome assembly and its metrics, produced by computational assembly and BUSCO analysis of sequencing reads that can be re-run by a third party.

quotes.quote: with highly contiguous scaffolds (scaffold N50 = 19 Mb). Based on universal single-copy orthologs, we estimated a gene space completeness of 96.6% for the draft genome assembly.

The contig N50 was 155 kb and the scaffold N50 was 19 Mb. We found 96.6% complete single-copy genes relative to the BUSCO v. 5 aves_odb10 database [BUSCO score: C: 96.6% (S: 94.7%, D: 1.9%), F: 0.7%, M: 2.7%, n : 8,338],

G2.rationale: The paper states the scaffold N50 and BUSCO completeness as principal assembly metrics in the abstract and results; scaffold N50 is the primary numerical endpoint for assembly contiguity.

quotes.quote: All data for this project are available publicly at NCBI under BioProject Accession PRJNA851081, including raw Illumina reads (SRA SRR21604398) and the genome contig assembly (WGS JANVCC000000000 ).

G3.rationale: The deposit listing provided is empty, so it cannot be confirmed that the listed files are the raw analysis inputs; the paper points to NCBI accessions instead.

quotes.quote: We assembled the genome using 10X Supernova ( Weisenfeld et al. 2017 ) with default options. To fill gaps in the reference genome, we used the ABySS Sealer program ( Paulino et al. 2015 ) with

We further assessed genome completeness using BUSCO v. 5 ( Manni et al. 2021 ) and by aligning our draft genome assembly to 2 related species in the Afroaves clade with high-quality chromosome-level assemblies available on GenBank

G4.rationale: The assembly and BUSCO methods are described with software names, versions, and default options, sufficient to implement without original code.

G5.rationale: Supernova, ABySS Sealer, and BUSCO are freely available software; no proprietary software is required for the target.
